activation_aggregation: arithmetic mean of input_rms across sample_id, independently per tensor and input column
importance: absolute source weight multiplied by the aggregated activation for that input column

sparsity_pattern.grouping: consecutive non-overlapping input-column groups starting at column 0

selection: keep the two greatest importance scores in every group
excluded_tensor_rule: copy every ineligible tensor value exactly
numeric_policy: preserve retained source weights exactly; write pruned weights as numeric zero
